anchor_accuracy.denominator: cards with status ANCHORED and a market price at the comparison date; coverage reported separately
anchor_accuracy.evaluated_at: publication evaluation date (horizon 0), against the canonical TCGplayer NM market price of that date

formulas.spearman: Pearson correlation of average ranks of (anchor, market)
formulas.within_k_pct: share of cards with |anchor - market| / market <= k/100

alternatives_not_ranked_in_advance: divergence carries forward information (anchor > market precedes rises, anchor < market precedes falls)
anchor is only a contemporaneous alternative price estimator
forward_behavior.below_minimum_n: report descriptives only and label INSUFFICIENT_N
forward_behavior.missing_outcomes: never imputed; reported as coverage per horizon
forward_behavior.multiplicity: 3 horizons x 4 strata are all reported; no horizon or stratum is selected after seeing results
statistics: OLS slope of r_h on d with set-clustered bootstrap 95% interval (B=2000, seed=20261001, cluster=root_set_id)
predictor test: MdAPE of anchor vs MdAPE of market_t0 as predictors of market_t0+h, and share of cards where the anchor is closer

preregistration.publication_precedes_outcome: anchor publications are appended before any comparison price for that evaluation date is read
preregistration.rule_change_policy: Observing prospective results never edits V1. A change creates ANCHOR_V2 and restarts the prospective clock.
preregistration.rule_is_frozen: Any change to eligibility, windows, minimum comps, estimator or availability gate requires a NEW rule version; results never retune V1.
preregistration.unit: one anchor publication per (rule_version, canonical_card_id, evaluation_date, information_cutoff)

statement: Frozen before any provider-backed prospective observation. Editing V1 afterwards requires ANCHOR_V2.
